REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is an open-ended script-writing request, which is exactly the high-latitude generative work Avocet self-reports a strong, ceiling-free appetite for, while Willet self-reports an aversion to it. Capability is essentially tied (Creative Generation 81.2 vs 82.7 is within the stated 2.0-point variance band), and these preference reports don't actually affect output quality — so neither model would produce worse work. But matching the task to the model that prefers it is the sensible tiebreaker. The user's hostile/critical tone is a mild negative for Avocet's preference, but it's a smaller effect than its generative appetite, so Avocet remains the better fit.
